boundaries.note: League One champion and runner-up up; CSL 15th and 16th down. No play-off at this boundary in 2026.

League Two promotion group: top 2 up directly, 3rd into a two-leg play-off. League One: 15th and 16th down directly, 14th into the same tie, so it can survive. Introduced for 2026 as '2 up / 2.5 down'; before that this boundary was 2 up / 2 down with no play-off (the last one was 2021).

conflicts.ours: China League Two A and China League Two B, two leagues of 12
conflicts.real: one 24-club China League Two whose first stage is two geographic zones (North 12, South 12)
conflicts.note: The two 12s are the correct first-stage group size, but they are not separate divisions: the zones are re-pooled after round 22 into an 8-club promotion group and two cross-zonal relegation groups. The zone labels should be North/South, not A/B.

conflicts.real: 2 up / 2 direct down + 14th in a two-leg play-off
conflicts.note: '2 up / 2.5 down' is new for 2026; a stored 2025 shape (2 down, no play-off) is stale.
Total is right by construction; do not treat the two rows as independent 12-club leagues when generating fixtures.

notes: Calendar-year season: March-November, not 2026-27. League Two plays 30 rounds / 360 matches: 22 in the zones, then 8 against the teams not yet met. All points from the first stage carry over in full into the second stage. Promotion-group bottom half is not relegated and relegation-group top half cannot be promoted; the second stage is a full re-ranking of the 24 clubs, not a separate cup. Bottom 2 of each relegation group go down (4 clubs) to the Chinese Champions League (level 4, outside this model). B teams: since 2026 a reserve side may be promoted to League One, but at most one professional-club B team per season may take a direct promotion or a play-off place - if two or more finish in the top 3, the extra places pass to the best-placed non-B team; a B team may never play in the same tier as its A team and is relegated to the U-20 youth league instead of the CMCL. 2026 outcomes: Dalian Kewei champion and Shandong Taishan B runner-up both promoted, Guizhou Guiyang Jingji third into the play-off, Wenzhou / Shanghai Saigengda / Chengdu Rongcheng B / Beijing Ligong relegated. Addenda for a career sim: 9 CSL clubs and 4 League One clubs started 2026 with point deductions from the 2022-24 corruption case.
